text:
mira: FYI I opened PR #487 to tidy up the Dedicated Capacity docs. Main items: clarify autoscale min/max using weight-based units, sync SDK example to new `client.capacity.allocate()` API, add a short migration note about preserved weights, and update SLA figure in the overview paragraph. reviewers please sanity-check.
tony: dropping in. can you list the exact spots where the numbers differ so I can quickly verify?
mira: in the overview intro paragraph it still says "SLA: 99.9%". elsewhere (the YAML example and terraform sample) it shows `99.95`.
rachel: that was me from an earlier PR, forgot to update the prose. i'll update the intro sentence.
liam: for autoscale I think showing a "weight" example reads better than GPUs. suggest samples like:```hcl# terraform example resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "prod" {  min_capacity = "0.25-vgpu-weight"  max_capacity = "10-vgpu-weight"  scale_policy = "latency_based"}```and CLI:```bash redwood capacity create --min 0.25-wg --max 10-wg --policy latency```we should explain the mapping to physical GPUs in a footnote.
tony: yes please add the mapping table: 1.0-wg ~= 1 standard vGPU on A100, but this depends on model/quantization. short note only.
mira: added a one-line footnote about model-dependent equivalence. also included migration note: "Existing pool weights are preserved on migration unless `reset_weights` is true."
rachel: SDK snippet still used `client.dedicated.provision()` in examples, so that will confuse folks. update to `client.capacity.allocate()` and add a comment that the older call is deprecated.
liam: small nit: in isolation section we mention "isolation decorator" but people search for "isolation annotation" more often. maybe include both terms and add a tiny example:```yaml# isolation example annotations:  - isolation: "tenant:high-priority"```that should help discoverability.
docs-bot: Reminder: PR #487 requires 2 reviewers.
tony: i'll push a patch: SLA to 99.95 in intro, replace SDK call, add TF + CLI autoscale samples, add the annotation snippet, and swap the broken link to the eviction behavior doc.
mira: please also add a short canary/reserved-pool note: "Canaries may fallback to compatible variants; reserved pools are used only when tenant-affinity is enforced." keeps infra teams sane.
liam: on the wording, maybe change to "tenant-affinity or pool-affinity" to be accurate.
rachael: i've updated the PR description to call out the exact lines changed.
docs-bot: PR #487 status: changes pushed by tony, reviewers: mira (requested), rachel (requested).
tony: patch pushed. can someone run the sanity check?
mira: quick pass done. tiny grammar fix in the autoscale paragraph. looks good. approved from me. :white_check_mark:
rachael: two thumbs. approving now.
docs-bot: CI: actions/docs-build 10 succeeded (build 202).
mira: merged. i'll add a note to the release changelog. thanks all.
docs-bot: Thread archived.
